description: This Java class defines the LwM2mRPkCredentials, which manages elliptic curve public/private keys and certificates for LwM2m security in Thingsboard.

classes.name: LwM2mRPkCredentials
classes.description: A class for managing elliptic curve RPK credentials, including generating public/private keys from X and Y coordinates and a private scalar.

methods.name: LwM2mRPkCredentials
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the credentials by generating keys from provided X, Y, and S values.

methods.name: generatePublicKeyRPK
methods.description: Generates server public and private keys based on elliptic curve parameters and provided coordinate strings.
